However, no upward revision in GST beyond original delivery period shall be admissible unless the delay is due to a ny lapse on the part of the purchaser. 22.The price quoted by bidder is calculated with NPV & ITC for L-1 evaluati on purpose. Therefore, if required, post RA accepted landed price shall be updated in GeM portal from the bac kend with the help of GeM authority for generation of contract on land ed price basis. 23.The contract value displayed in GeM Contract shall reflect the absolute value of Contract including GST. Item wise breakup as provided by the successful bidder to buyer post RA in absolute terms shall also be part of contract. 24.There is single line item in GeM Bid which have goods & service along wit h 4 years CAMC. Also, payment of CAMC is to be made within the respe ctive year of operation and there is no provision of advance year budget provision in our SAP for CAMC. Therefore, payment will be done directly to supplier by BCCL without CR AC in GeM portal.
